sentences.en: Everyone strives for efficiency but few seem to attain it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都追求效率，但似乎很少有人能够达到。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to explode the productive efficiency of its workers.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要提高工人的生产效率。

sentences.en: We believe these drastic measures will enhance our workers' efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们相信这些 drastic 措施将提升工人的工作效率。

senses.zh: 效率，效能；效率，生产力；（机器、装置等的）效能，功效

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ef（加强）+fici（做）+ency →做，发挥作用→效率
